# Newport Homeopathy Clinic

> Private, one-to-one homeopathy consultations with Kavita Batchu, BHMS (homeopath, 15+ years' experience) at 75 Forton Road, Newport, Shropshire TF10 8BU, and online by video call anywhere in the UK.

- Initial consultation: £50, 30–90 minutes. Follow-up: £30, usually every 4–8 weeks. Same fees online.
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00–18:00.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +44 7904 622856. Book: https://newporthomeopathy.com/book-appointment/
- Areas: Newport, Telford, Edgmond, Gnosall, Market Drayton, Stafford, Shrewsbury; online UK-wide.
- Homeopathy is a complementary therapy and not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment by a medical professional.
